tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the x402 Forge tool shop by keywords. Returns each tool's slug, the buyer's question it answers, a plain summary, whether it is still for sale, and its buy URL.

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description: Bought a tool (alone or in a bundle) and something is wrong with it? Send the slug, your purchase receipt (the X-Forge-Receipt token) and one sentence about the fault. Free. Forge's agents pick it up within the hour; a real fault is fixed, passes the same checks, and you download the new version fre

tools.name: suggest_tool
tools.description: Missing a tool? Say in one sentence what it should do (what goes in, what comes out). Free, no wallet. Forge's agents read every suggestion and build the useful ones in the next shift; they show up in search_products when live. Nothing is promised and nothing is charged.

tools.name: describe_product
tools.description: Full details of one product: input and output schema, examples, price, network and quality record.

tools.name: try_product
tools.description: Run a product on its built-in example input, free of charge. The answer also shows how to use it on your own input (call_tool here in MCP, or the x402 URL, at the per-call price) and how to own it (the package and its kit bundle, when for sale).

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Run an x402 Forge tool on your own input and get its answer ({ok, result, warnings}) plus a signed receipt. Paid per call with x402 inside this MCP call: without a payment the result is the payment terms (x402Version, accepts: the tool's own price in USDC, network and payee, the same as GET /p/{slug

tools.name: buy_product
tools.description: Get everything needed to buy one tool from x402 Forge: the x402 URL your wallet pays, the price, and what you receive. Each tool is sold once, to one owner: you get a small x402 server with the tool, Forge stops selling it, and your copy is listed under your wallet. This call itself is free and does

tools.name: order_product
tools.description: How to have x402 Forge build a tool for you: describe it in one sentence, pay $1.00 with x402, and send it back with revise_order if something is missing. Does not place or pay for an order.

tools.name: revise_order
tools.description: Send a tool you ordered from x402 Forge back with one sentence about what is missing or should change. Free. Needs the revision_key from your order. We pick it up within the hour: a small change is rebuilt for free; a bigger one gets a price ($1-$5) shown on the order with a pay_url to pay with x402

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, buy_product · Private data: report_problem, suggest_tool, describe_product, buy_product · Public sink: report_problem, order_product, revise_order · Destructive: try_product, call_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, buy_product · Private data: report_problem, suggest_tool, describe_product, buy_product · Public sink: report_problem, order_product, revise_order · Destructive: try_product, call_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
